verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for it. The pack has no evidence of API keys, tokens, or scoped credentials, and all OpenAPI probes returned 404. The only related evidence is group-based role assignment for human user permissions, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
